marinara.name: marinara sauce (no sugar added, 24 oz jar)

steakseason.name: steak seasoning (Kinder's Prime Steak, Montreal, or Amazing Taste Steakhouse)

elote.name: Trader Joe's Everything but the Elote

brisketrub.name: BBQ rub (brisket seasoning or Buffalo Trace blend)

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Egg Bites with Turkey Sausage
recipes.blurb: Your current egg bites, upgraded: blended cottage cheese makes them custardy like the coffee-shop version, and homemade turkey sausage adds real protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F and grease two 12-cup muffin tins well (silicone pans release easiest).

Brown the turkey in a skillet with the maple, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, crushed red pepper, ½ tsp salt, and pepper. Add the bell pepper and spinach for the last 2 minutes, then let it cool a bit.
Blend the eggs, cottage cheese, and remaining ½ tsp salt until completely smooth, about 30 seconds.
Divide the sausage mixture and cheddar among the cups, then pour the egg blend over the top, filling each about ¾ full.
Set a pan of hot water on the rack below and bake 25–30 minutes, until just set in the center. The steam is what keeps them silky instead of spongy.
Cool 10 minutes in the tin before popping them out.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days, or freeze on a sheet pan then bag for up to 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec from the fridge, 90 sec from frozen.

recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
recipes.blurb: Loaded with turkey sausage, eggs, crispy potatoes, and black beans. Make a dozen and you're covered on the busiest mornings.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and a pinch of salt, then air fry at 400°F for 15–18 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, brown the turkey with the fajita seasoning in a large skillet. Stir in the black beans and move everything to a big bowl.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, and remaining salt and pepper. Soft-scramble over medium-low heat and pull them a little early, since they cook more when reheated.
Fold the eggs, potatoes, and cheddar into the turkey mixture and let it cool 10 minutes. Hot filling steams the tortillas and makes them soggy.
Cook the uncooked tortillas per the package, about 30 seconds a side. Add a spoonful of salsa and about ¾ cup filling to each, roll tightly, and wrap in foil or parchment.
Freeze flat in a gallon bag.
recipes.storage: Freezer up to 3 months; fridge 3 days.
recipes.reheat: Unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel, and microwave 2–2½ min, flipping halfway. For a crisp shell, finish 3 min in the air fryer at 375°F.
recipes.notes: Uncooked tortillas (TortillaLand) are just flour, water, oil, and salt, the closest thing to fresh bread you'll find in a tortilla.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato & Turkey Sausage Hash with Jammy Eggs
recipes.blurb: Sheet-pan sweet potatoes, maple-sage-style turkey sausage, peppers, and pre-peeled jammy eggs. Sweet, savory, and filling.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes, onion, and peppers with the oil and Kinder's veggie rub, then spread across two sheet pans. Roast 25–30 minutes, flipping once, until browned at the edges.
Brown the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and crushed red pepper, breaking it into small crumbles. Wilt the spinach in at the end.
Jammy eggs: lower the eggs into boiling water, cook 7 minutes, and move them straight into ice water. Peel once cool.
Toss the roasted vegetables with the turkey and portion into containers. Pack the eggs whole in the corner, or separately.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Peeled eggs keep 4 days.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the hash 1½–2 min. Add the egg after reheating, either cold or for 15 seconds, so it doesn't explode or go rubbery.

recipes.title: High-Protein Berry Overnight Oats
recipes.blurb: Ten minutes, zero cooking. Greek yogurt and whey make it creamy and pack 35+ grams into the big jars.
steps: In a big bowl, whisk the yogurt, almond milk, whey, maple, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until there are no protein lumps.
Stir in the oats and chia.
Divide into 8 jars (4 big, 4 smaller) and top each with frozen berries. They thaw overnight and bleed into the oats.
Refrigerate at least 6 hours.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Make Sunday for Mon–Thu.
recipes.reheat: Eat cold, or microwave 1–1½ min and stir if you want warm oats.
recipes.notes: {A}: add 2 hard-boiled eggs or a cheese stick to land at 45 g.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Sheet-Pan Egg Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: A big tray of turkey, spinach, tomato, and feta eggs cut into squares and stacked on toasted sourdough English muffins.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line a 13×18 sheet pan with parchment that goes up the sides (it releases far better than spray alone).
Brown the turkey with the oregano, garlic powder, and ½ tsp salt.
Blend or whisk the eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, remaining salt, and pepper until smooth.
Scatter the turkey, spinach, tomatoes, red onion, and feta over the pan, then pour the eggs over evenly.
Bake 18–22 minutes, until the center no longer jiggles. Cool, then cut into 12 squares.
Pack squares with split English muffins. Toast the muffins at eating time if you can.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Squares freeze 2 months between sheets of parchment.
recipes.reheat: Square: 45–60 sec in the microwave. Muffin: toaster or 3 min in the air fryer.

source.name: Clemson Extension – Stirring Up Healthy Recipes

recipes.title: Freezer Sausage, Egg & Cheese Sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Better than drive-thru. Homemade turkey sausage patties, baked egg rounds, and sharp cheddar on sourdough English muffins.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin, or use a parchment-lined 9×13 and cut squares.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites with half the salt and pour into the tin. Bake 15–18 minutes, until set.
Mix the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, crushed red pepper, remaining salt, and pepper. Form 12 thin patties a little wider than the muffins, since they shrink.
Cook the patties in a skillet over medium-high, 3 minutes a side.
Build: muffin, patty, egg, cheddar, muffin. Cool completely, then wrap each in parchment and foil.
recipes.reheat: From frozen: unwrap, wrap in a paper towel, and microwave 60–90 sec at 50% power, then 30 sec at full. Or air fry 8 min at 320°F.

recipes.title: Kodiak Cottage Cheese Blender Pancakes
recipes.blurb: Uses the Kodiak mix you already have plus cottage cheese and egg whites. Fluffy, freezable, and 40+ grams in a stack.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, egg whites, almond milk, vanilla, and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a bowl and fold in the Kodiak mix until just combined. Rest 5 minutes while the pan heats.
Cook ¼-cup scoops on a buttered griddle or nonstick pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes a side. They brown fast because of the cheese.
Cool on a rack, then pack 4 or 2 per container with yogurt and berries in a separate cup.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; freezer 2 months (freeze flat, then bag).
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec, or the toaster from frozen.

recipes.title: Turkey Sausage, Egg & Potato Breakfast Bowls
recipes.blurb: Your breakfast bowls, dialed in: crispy air-fried potatoes, sausage-seasoned turkey, fluffy eggs, cheddar, and salsa on the side.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and Dan-O's, then air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes, shaking twice.
Brown the turkey with the maple, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Add the peppers and onion and cook 5 more minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites and scramble softly in a separate pan, keeping them slightly wet.
Layer potatoes, turkey and pepper mix, and eggs in containers, then top with cheddar. Pack salsa on the side.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½–2 min, stirring once. Add salsa after.

recipes.title: Sourdough Sausage & Cheddar Strata
recipes.blurb: The weekend brunch casserole you can actually meal prep. Uses real sourdough, assembles the night before, and bakes Sunday morning.
steps: Brown the turkey with the Weber garlic & herb, paprika, and onion. Wilt in the spinach.
Grease a 9×13 and layer half the bread, half the turkey mix, and half the cheddar. Repeat.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cottage cheese, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then pour over evenly, pressing the bread down so it soaks.
Top with parmesan, cover, and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Bake covered at 350°F for 30 minutes, then uncovered 20–25 more, until puffed and set. Rest 10 minutes and cut into 12.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; freeze individual squares 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1–1½ min, or 6 min in the air fryer at 330°F for crispy edges.

recipes.title: Blueberry Banana Baked Protein Oatmeal
recipes.blurb: Tastes like banana bread, eats like breakfast. Blended cottage cheese and whey keep it moist and high-protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13.
Blend the bananas, cottage cheese, yogurt, eggs, almond milk, maple, and vanilla until smooth.
In a big bowl, stir together the oats, whey, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Pour in the wet mix and stir well.
Fold in most of the berries, spread in the pan, and scatter the rest on top.
Bake 35–40 minutes, until set and golden at the edges. Cool fully before cutting, or it'll be gummy.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec. Great with a spoon of Greek yogurt on top.
recipes.notes: {A}: add a Greek yogurt cup or 2 eggs on the side to clear 45 g.

recipes.title: Beef Chorizo-Style Egg Muffins
recipes.blurb: Homemade chorizo seasoning on lean ground beef (no mystery-meat sausage) plus green chiles and cheddar. Uses your freezer beef.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two 12-cup muffin tins.
Brown the beef, then stir in the chili powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, cinnamon, vinegar, and ½ tsp salt. Cook 1 minute until fragrant. Add the bell pepper and green chiles.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites, and remaining salt.
Divide the beef mixture and cheddar among the cups, then pour the eggs over, filling ¾ full.
Bake 20–22 minutes, until set. Top with cilantro.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 45–60 sec. Salsa or hot sauce on top.

recipes.title: Steak & Egg Breakfast Hash Bowls
recipes.blurb: Diner-style steak and eggs: seared sirloin with your Kinder's Prime Steak, crispy potatoes, peppers, and onions.
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the Weber garlic parmesan, then air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.

Pat the steak dry and season with the steak seasoning. Sear in a ripping-hot skillet with the remaining oil, 3–4 minutes a side for medium-rare (it'll cook more on reheat). Rest 10 minutes and slice thin against the grain.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft and charred, about 6 minutes.
Soft-scramble the eggs with the salt.
Divide potatoes, peppers and onion, eggs, and steak into bowls.
recipes.reheat: Microwave at 70% power for 2 min so the steak doesn't overcook. Hot sauce after.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Protein Mac
recipes.blurb: Your house favorite, rebuilt in one pot. Lean beef, protein pasta cooked right in broth, real cheddar, and a Greek-yogurt finish for creaminess without the processed cheese sauce.
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot or deep skillet, about 8 minutes. Season with the burger seasoning, garlic powder, and smoked paprika.
Stir in the tomato paste, mustard, and Worcestershire and cook 1 minute.
Add the broth, milk, and pasta. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on medium-low 10–12 minutes, stirring every few minutes so nothing sticks, until the pasta is tender.
Take it off the heat. Stir in the cheddar until melted, then the Greek yogurt.
Top with chopped pickles. That's the cheeseburger magic.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion; measure the spices into a small jar.
recipes.reheat: Add a splash of milk and microwave 2 min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: Big Mac Bowls with Crispy Potatoes
recipes.blurb: All the Big Mac flavor (special sauce, pickles, cheddar, onion) over seasoned beef and air-fried potatoes. A meal-prep crowd favorite.
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil and Dan-O's, then air fry at 400°F for 18–22 minutes, shaking twice.
Brown the beef with the burger seasoning and onion powder. Drain if needed.
Special sauce: stir together the yogurt, relish, ketchup, mustard, vinegar, paprika, and garlic powder.
Pack the hot side (beef, potatoes, cheddar) in the main container. Pack lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles cold and separate, with sauce in a small cup.
recipes.prep: Make the special sauce and chop the lettuce, tomato, and onion (keep them separate, in paper-towel-lined containers).
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days, cold toppings packed separately.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the beef and potatoes 1½–2 min, or air fry 5 min at 375°F to re-crisp. Then add the cold stuff and sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Burrito Bowls with Cilantro-Lime Rice
recipes.blurb: Chipotle-style bowls at home: fajita-spiced beef, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, charred corn and peppers, cheese, and a yogurt 'sour cream'.
steps: Cook the rice. When done, fold in the lime juice, half the cilantro, and a pinch of salt.
Brown the beef with the fajita seasoning and a splash of water, simmering until saucy.
In a hot skillet with the oil, char the peppers, onion, and corn for 6–8 minutes.
Warm the black beans with a pinch of salt.
Build bowls: rice, beans, beef, veggies, cheddar. Pack salsa, yogurt, and the rest of the cilantro on the side.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; slice the peppers and onion.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; beef and rice freeze 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a damp paper towel over the rice. Toppings go on after.

recipes.title: Korean-Inspired Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
recipes.blurb: The one Asian-leaning dinner in the rotation, and an easy one: sweet-savory garlic-ginger beef over rice with broccoli. On the table in 25 minutes.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the beef in a large skillet until crispy in spots. Push it to the side and cook the garlic and ginger in the drippings for 30 seconds.
Stir in the liquid aminos, maple, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper. Simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy.
Steam or microwave the broccoli and carrots until crisp-tender.
Bowls: rice, beef with its sauce, then the vegetables.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; shred the carrots.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef & Sweet Potato Chili
recipes.blurb: Hearty, smoky, a little sweet from the sweet potatoes. Set it in the morning, and it's even better on day two.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, jalapeño powder, salt, and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Scrape everything into the slow cooker with the sweet potatoes, beans, tomatoes, and broth.
Cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Taste and adjust the salt. Top with cheddar and yogurt when serving.
recipes.prep: Dice the sweet potatoes and onion. Brown the beef the night before if you want a dump-and-go morning.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Steak & Potato Bowls
recipes.blurb: Seared sirloin with a bright, garlicky chimichurri, crispy roasted potatoes, and green beans. Feels like a steakhouse plate.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the butcher seasoning, then roast 30–35 minutes. Add the green beans to the pan for the last 12 minutes.
Chimichurri: mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, red wine vinegar, crushed red pepper, salt, and 3 tbsp olive oil (beyond the oil above). Let it sit while you cook.
Pat the steak dry, season with the steak seasoning, and sear in a very hot skillet, 4–5 minutes a side for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes and slice against the grain.
Bowls: potatoes, green beans, steak. Chimichurri in a small cup.
recipes.prep: Make the chimichurri (it's better after a day) and cut the potatoes into water.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Steak is best on days 1–3.
recipes.reheat: Microwave at 70% power 1½–2 min so the steak stays pink. Chimichurri goes on after.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
recipes.blurb: All the cheesesteak (shaved steak, onions, mushrooms, melty provolone) baked into peppers with a little rice so it's a full meal.
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F and set the pepper halves cut-side up in a 9×13. Bake them empty for 10 minutes to soften.
Season the steak with the steak seasoning and sear it in batches in a hot skillet with the oil, 1–2 minutes. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and mushrooms until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and Worcestershire.
Toss the steak, vegetables, and rice together, then pack into the peppers.
Top each with a provolone slice and bake 15 minutes, until bubbly.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; slice the onion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave covered, 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Baked Meatballs Marinara with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Tender beef-and-turkey meatballs baked on a sheet pan (no frying mess), simmered in good marinara, over protein pasta. Double it and freeze half.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Soak the panko in the milk for 2 minutes, then gently mix with the meats, eggs, parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic, parsley, and salt. Don't overwork it, or the meatballs get tough.
Roll into about 24 balls, a heaping tablespoon each, and bake 15–18 minutes.
Simmer the marinara, add the meatballs, and let them hang out 5 minutes.
Cook the pasta 1 minute short of the package time. Portion pasta, meatballs, and sauce, then top with mozzarella.
recipes.prep: Mix and roll the meatballs and refrigerate them on the pan, ready to bake.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; meatballs in sauce freeze 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Add a splash of water if the pasta looks dry.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie
recipes.blurb: Savory beef and veggie filling under a creamy sweet potato mash with a cheddar crust. Cozy, and freezes perfectly.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes in salted water 15 minutes, until very tender. Drain and mash with the yogurt, butter, and ½ tsp salt.
Meanwhile, brown the beef with the onion and carrots. Add the garlic, tomato paste, Worcestershire, Italian seasoning, and remaining salt and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and simmer 8 minutes, until thick. Stir in the peas.
Spread the filling in a 9×13, spoon the mash over, and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, then broil 2 minutes for color.
recipes.prep: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes; dice the onion and carrots.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Beef Gyro Bowls with Tzatziki & Lemon Rice
recipes.blurb: Gyro-spiced crispy beef, lemony rice, homemade tzatziki, and a crunchy cucumber-tomato-feta salad. Fresh and filling.
steps: Cook the rice and stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Brown the beef in a hot skillet. Let it sit undisturbed so it crisps, then season with the oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Tzatziki: squeeze the grated cucumber dry in a towel and mix with the yogurt, minced garlic, dill, the remaining lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Salad: toss the diced cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and feta with the vinegar and oil.
Pack the rice and beef warm. Salad and tzatziki go in separate cups.
recipes.prep: Make the tzatziki and chop the salad (dress it day-of); cook the rice.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the rice and beef 1½–2 min. Salad and tzatziki stay cold.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbacoa Bowls
recipes.blurb: Fall-apart chipotle-lime beef, the copycat everyone loves. Pile it on rice with beans and crunchy slaw.
steps: Blend the chipotles, adobo, lime juice, vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, and broth into a smooth sauce.
Put the beef in the slow cooker and pour the sauce over. Cook on LOW 8 hours, until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks and stir it back into the juices. This keeps it moist for days.
Cook the rice. Bowls: rice, beans, barbacoa with a spoon of juice, and slaw with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.prep: Blend the sauce and refrigerate it with the beef so it's dump-and-go in the morning.
recipes.storage: Fridge 5 days; shredded beef freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Keep the slaw separate.
recipes.notes: Want it milder? Use 1 chipotle and skip the adobo.

recipes.title: Sourdough Smash Patty Melts & Potato Wedges
recipes.blurb: Your burger night, perfected. Smashed lean patties, jammy onions, and cheddar griddled between sourdough, plus air-fried wedges. Prep ahead, griddle fresh.
steps: Caramelize the onions in 1 tbsp butter over medium-low heat, 20–25 minutes, with a pinch of salt. Do this on prep day.
Air fry the wedges, tossed with the oil and Dan-O's, at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.
Sauce: yogurt, ketchup, relish, and Dijon.
Smash the beef balls thin onto a screaming-hot skillet, season with the burger seasoning, cook 2 minutes, flip, and add cheese.
Build on sourdough with sauce and onions, then griddle in the remaining butter until golden, 2–3 minutes a side.
For tomorrow's lunch, pack the patties, onions, and bread separately and assemble fresh.
recipes.prep: Caramelize the onions; portion the beef into balls; cut the wedges into water.
recipes.reheat: Rebuild the melt and air fry 5–6 min at 360°F. It's way better than a microwave here.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Sweet Potato Skillet
recipes.blurb: One skillet: taco-spiced turkey, tender sweet potatoes, black beans, and corn under melty cheddar. Big flavor, minimal dishes.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper in a large lidded skillet. Add the spices and salt.
Stir in the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, and broth. Cover and simmer 15–18 minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Stir in the beans and corn and heat through.
Top with cheddar, cover 2 minutes to melt, then finish with cilantro and lime.
recipes.prep: Dice the sweet potatoes, onion, and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Greek Turkey Burger Bowls
recipes.blurb: Juicy turkey patties with feta and spinach mixed right in, so they never dry out, over rice with tzatziki and tomatoes.
steps: Gently mix the turkey, feta, spinach, grated onion, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Form 8 patties.
Sear in the oil over medium-high, 4–5 minutes a side, until they hit 165°F.
Cook the rice.
Quick tzatziki: squeeze the grated cucumber dry and mix with the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and a pinch of salt.
Bowls: rice, 2 patties, sliced cucumber, tomatoes. Tzatziki on the side.
recipes.prep: Mix and form the patties (separate them with parchment); cook the rice; make the tzatziki.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; cooked patties freeze 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½–2 min.

recipes.title: Turkey Bolognese with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: A slow-simmered meat sauce with carrot, celery, and a splash of milk for that classic silky texture. Makes Sunday smell amazing.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot, and celery in the oil until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the turkey and break it up very fine. Brown it, then add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Splash in the vinegar, then the crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and red pepper. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the milk and simmer 5 more minutes.
Toss with the cooked pasta and top with parmesan.
recipes.prep: Finely dice the onion, carrot, and celery (or pulse them in the food processor).
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Classic Turkey Chili
recipes.blurb: A proper thick, beefy-tasting chili that happens to be turkey. Serve over rice or a baked sweet potato.
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil and break it up well. Add the onion and peppers and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, spices, salt, and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Simmer partly covered 30 minutes, until thick.
Cook the rice. Serve the chili over it with cheddar and yogurt.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion and peppers; cook the rice.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: Italian Turkey Stuffed Peppers
recipes.blurb: Classic stuffed peppers: Italian-seasoned turkey, rice, and tomatoes under a melty mozzarella lid.
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F and pre-bake the pepper halves 10 minutes.
Brown the turkey with the onion, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, and rice and simmer 5 minutes.
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella and parmesan, cover with foil, and bake 20 minutes. Uncover for 5 more.
recipes.prep: Cook the rice; halve and seed the peppers.
recipes.reheat: Microwave covered 2–2½ min.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Turkey Taco Pasta
recipes.blurb: Taco night meets mac and cheese. Turkey, salsa, green chiles, and protein pasta cooked together, then finished creamy with cheddar.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper, then add the spices and salt.
Add the salsa, tomatoes, chiles, broth, and pasta. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Off the heat, stir in the cream cheese, then the cheddar. Top with cilantro.
recipes.prep: Dice the onion and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Splash of water or broth and microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Turkey Sloppy Joes on Toasted Sourdough
recipes.blurb: Homemade sauce (no canned stuff): tangy, a little sweet, piled on toasted sourdough with sweet potato fries.
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and pepper. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, Worcestershire, vinegar, maple, mustard, chili powder, and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Toss the sweet potato fries with the oil and paprika and air fry at 400°F for 15–18 minutes.
Toast the sourdough. Pile on the joe and top with cheddar.
recipes.prep: Make the sloppy joe filling entirely (it's better the next day); cut the fries.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the filling 1½ min; toast the bread fresh; air fry the fries 4 min.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls with Garlic Yogurt Sauce
recipes.blurb: Warm-spiced, yogurt-marinated chicken roasted until the edges char, over rice with cucumber-tomato salad and a garlicky white sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in ¼ cup yogurt, 2 tbsp lemon juice, the oil, all the spices, half the minced garlic, and 1 tsp salt. Give it at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Roast on a sheet pan at 425°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 2–3 minutes to char. Rest and slice.
Sauce: 1 cup yogurt, the remaining garlic and lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice. Bowls: rice, chicken, cucumber, tomato, red onion, and sauce on the side.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cook the rice; chop the salad.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; cooked chicken freezes 2 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave the rice and chicken 1½–2 min. The salad and sauce stay cold.
recipes.notes: Breasts work too. Pull them at 160°F so they stay juicy.

ingredients.n: ¼ cup for marinade, 1 cup for sauce

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Bowls with Yogurt Ranch
recipes.blurb: Wing-night flavor on a weekday: buffalo-tossed chicken, crispy potatoes, broccoli, and a cool homemade ranch using your ranch seasoning.
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and garlic powder and air fry at 400°F for 18–20 minutes.
Season the chicken with the kick'n chicken and remaining oil. Roast at 425°F for 15–18 minutes (or air fry in batches, 10 minutes). Roast the broccoli on the same pan.
Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss with the hot chicken.
Ranch: yogurt, ranch seasoning, and milk to thin.
Bowls: potatoes, broccoli, buffalo chicken, celery. Ranch on the side.
recipes.prep: Cube the chicken and season it; make the ranch.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min, or air fry 5 min at 375°F to re-crisp.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.blurb: Two ingredients do the heavy lifting: chicken plus salsa in the slow cooker equals juicy shredded chicken for bowls all week.
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker, sprinkle with the fajita seasoning, and pour the salsa over. Cook LOW 4–5 hours or HIGH 2½–3.
Shred right in the pot and stir in the lime juice. Let it soak up the juices for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice and stir in half the cilantro.
Bowls: rice, beans, corn, chicken, and cheddar. Yogurt and avocado added fresh.
recipes.prep: Load the slow cooker insert and refrigerate it overnight; cook the rice.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; shredded chicken freezes 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, spinach, and parmesan in a light creamy sauce (cream cheese and milk, no heavy cream) with seared chicken.
steps: Cook the pasta 1 minute short of the package time. Save ½ cup of the pasta water.
Season the chicken with the garlic parmesan and Italian seasoning. Sear in the oil 6–7 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute. Add the broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Whisk in the milk and cream cheese until smooth, then the parmesan. Simmer 2 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach, add the chicken, red pepper, and pasta, and loosen with pasta water as needed.
recipes.prep: Cube and season the chicken; chop the sun-dried tomatoes.
recipes.reheat: Splash of milk and microwave 2 min, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken & Sweet Potato Bowls with Crunchy Slaw
recipes.blurb: Uses your BBQ rub and sauce collection. Rubbed, sauced, and caramelized chicken, roasted sweet potatoes and corn, and a tangy yogurt slaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and roast 25–30 minutes. Add the corn for the last 10.
Rub the chicken with the BBQ rub and roast on a second pan 15 minutes. Brush with half the BBQ sauce and roast 8–10 more, until caramelized.
Slaw: toss the cabbage with the yogurt, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt.
Slice the chicken and toss with the remaining sauce. Bowls: sweet potatoes, corn, chicken. Slaw packed separately.
recipes.prep: Cube the sweet potatoes; rub the chicken; make the slaw dressing.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min. Slaw stays cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Bright and fast. Seared chicken, protein pasta, pesto lightened with Greek yogurt, burst cherry tomatoes, and spinach.
steps: Cook the pasta and save ½ cup of the water.
Season the chicken with the Kinder's wood-fired garlic and sear in the oil until cooked through.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and cook until they blister and pop, about 4 minutes. Wilt in the spinach.
Stir the pesto, yogurt, and lemon together, then toss with the pasta, chicken mix, and splashes of pasta water.
Top with parmesan and mozzarella.
recipes.prep: Cube and season the chicken.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days. Also good cold, like a pasta salad.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 1½ min, or eat cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.blurb: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred under the broiler, then simmered in a rich, warmly spiced tomato sauce. Lighter than takeout, just as good.
steps: Marinate the chicken with ½ cup yogurt, half the spices, half the garlic and ginger, and 1 tsp salt (30 minutes to overnight).
Spread on a foil-lined sheet pan and broil 8–10 minutes, until charred in spots.
Melt the butter and cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes. Add the remaining garlic, ginger, and spices and cook 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Whisk in the cream cheese and the remaining ½ cup yogurt off the heat so it doesn't split.
Add the chicken and simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice with cilantro.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cook the rice; dice the onion.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

ingredients.n: ½ for marinade, ½ for sauce

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Honey Garlic Chicken, Potatoes & Green Beans
recipes.blurb: Sticky honey-garlic glaze, crispy potatoes, and green beans, all on one pan. Minimal effort, big reward.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the Weber garlic & herb and roast 15 minutes.
Season the chicken with the Kinder's all-purpose. Push the potatoes aside, add the chicken and green beans tossed in the remaining oil, and roast 18–20 minutes.
Glaze: simmer the honey, aminos, garlic, vinegar, Dijon, and red pepper for 2 minutes.
Brush the glaze on the chicken and broil 2 minutes until sticky.
recipes.prep: Cut the potatoes; mix the glaze.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.
recipes.notes: Also great with chicken breasts. Use them to burn through freezer stock.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Rice Skillet
recipes.blurb: Everything you love about enchiladas (red sauce, beans, corn, gooey cheese) without rolling a single tortilla. The rice cooks right in the pan.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil with the cumin, chili powder, and salt. Set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper 4 minutes, then stir in the rice and toast 1 minute.
Add the enchilada sauce and broth, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low 18–20 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Stir in the chicken, beans, and corn, cover with cheddar, and lid it until melted. Finish with cilantro and yogurt.
recipes.prep: Cube the chicken; dice the onion and pepper.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parm Meatballs with Protein Pasta
recipes.blurb: Chicken parm in meatball form, with parmesan and garlic in the mix, baked in marinara under bubbling mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the chicken, egg, parmesan, panko, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and salt, and roll into about 24 meatballs. Wet hands help, since the mix is sticky.
Bake on a parchment-lined pan 15 minutes.
Move them to a baking dish, pour the marinara over, top with mozzarella, and bake 10 more minutes until bubbly.
Serve over cooked pasta with parsley.
recipes.prep: Roll the meatballs.
recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days; meatballs in sauce freeze 3 months.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.
recipes.notes: Want to use freezer breasts? Pulse 2 lb cubed breast in a food processor. Add 1 tbsp olive oil, since breast is leaner.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Greek Chicken & Lemon Potatoes
recipes.blurb: Lemon, garlic, and oregano chicken with crispy lemony potatoes and peppers, plus tzatziki and feta. A Mediterranean classic.
steps: Marinate the chicken in 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp oil, half the oregano, the garlic, and 1 tsp salt.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, the remaining oregano, garlic powder, and salt, and roast 20 minutes.
Add the chicken, onion, pepper, and zucchini (tossed in the last of the oil) and roast 20–22 minutes, until the chicken hits 160°F.
Tzatziki: the yogurt, squeezed cucumber, dill, the remaining lemon juice, and salt.
Slice the chicken and portion with the vegetables. Feta on top, tzatziki on the side.
recipes.prep: Marinate the chicken; cut the potatoes and vegetables; make the tzatziki.
recipes.reheat: Microwave 2 min.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Sandwiches on Sourdough
recipes.blurb: Your chicken sandwich night, leveled up. Yogurt-and-pickle-brined breast with a parmesan-panko crust, air fried crunchy, plus hot-honey sauce and sweet potato fries.
steps: Brine: coat the cutlets in ½ cup yogurt, the pickle juice, 1 tbsp hot sauce, and the kick'n chicken. Give it 30 minutes to overnight.
Mix the panko, parmesan, and paprika and press firmly onto the chicken. Mist with oil.
Air fry at 400°F for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until 160°F inside. Do the fries first (15–18 minutes), since they hold well.
Hot-honey sauce: ¼ cup yogurt, 1 tbsp hot sauce, and the honey.
Build on toasted sourdough with lettuce, tomato, and pickles. For lunch, pack the cutlet separately.
recipes.prep: Brine the chicken; cut the fries.
recipes.reheat: Air fry the cutlet 5 min at 370°F. The microwave makes it soggy. Toast the bread fresh.

ingredients.n: ½ cup brine, ¼ cup sauce
